gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all screen schemes to understand how screens are organized for different issue types.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all screen schemes with their details, including IDs, names, and associated screens.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to create a new screen scheme to customize the issue view for my team.
gold.ideal: The API should accept a JSON payload with the screen scheme details and return the created screen scheme's ID and a success message.

gold.user: As a project lead, I want to delete an obsolete screen scheme to keep our configuration clean and manageable.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the specified screen scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to update an existing screen scheme to add new screens for better issue tracking.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated screen scheme details and return the updated screen scheme's information along with a success message.
